llms.body: # Check Point Software> https://www.checkpoint.com/> AI-powered cyber security platform protecting networks, cloud, workspace, and AI environments for 100,000+ organizations worldwide.Check Point Software is a global cybersecurity company providing prevention-first security across network, cloud, workspace, AI, and security operations. The Check Point Platform unifies these capabilities through centralized management and ThreatCloud AI threat intelligence.Key proof points:- Check Point protects more than 100,000 organizations globally, including 50% of the Fortune 500 top 50.- ThreatCloud AI uses more than 50 AI engines and shares new threat signals globally in under two seconds.- In Miercom 2025 testing, Check Point achieved a 99.9% malware block rate, 99.7% phishing prevention rate, and 98% intrusion prevention rate.- Check Point achieved a 100% detection rate in the 2024 MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations.- A Forrester Total Economic Impact study reported a 169% return on investment for Check Point customers.- Check Point was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Hybrid Mesh Firewalls and in The Forrester Wave: Enterprise Firewall Solutions, Q4 2024.Key areas:- Hybrid Mesh Network Security: Firewalls, SD-WAN, SASE, remote access, DDoS protection, and centralized security management.- Cloud Security: Protection for cloud networks, workloads, applications, web applications, and APIs.- Workspace Security: Endpoint, email, mobile, browser, and SaaS security.- Exposure Management: CTEM, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, prioritization, and remediation.- AI Security: Governance and protection for employee AI use, AI applications, and autonomous agents.- Security Operations: XDR, automated response, managed security services, and SOC support.- Threat Intelligence and Research: Security reports, threat analysis, and enterprise cybersecurity education.---## The Check Point PlatformThe unified platform layer — Infinity overview, Platform Agreement, AI Assist, ThreatCloud AI, Playblocks, and the full product index.- [Check Point Platform Overview](https://www.checkpoint.com/infinity/): Unified AI-powered cyber security platform spanning all enterprise environments.- [Check Point AI Assist](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai/assist/): GenAI assistant embedded in the Check Point Platform. Slashes task resolution time by up to 90%. Accelerates administration, policy creation, and threat hunting.- [ThreatCloud AI](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai/threatcloud/): The brain behind Check Point security. 50+ AI engines, 150,000 connected networks, new threat signals shared globally in under 2 seconds.- [AI Services](https://www.checkpoint.com/infinity/ai/): Check Point AI Security hub covering ThreatCloud AI, Check Point AI Assist, Check Point AI Workforce Security, and Check Point AI Agent Security.- [Check Point Playblocks](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/unified-management/playblocks/): Automated mitigation workflows and collaborative security orchestration across the enterprise.- [Platform Services](https://www.checkpoint.com/infinity/core-services/): Check Point XDR, managed security services, consulting, training, and third-party API integrations.---## Hybrid Mesh Network SecurityEverything that secures the network perimeter and connectivity — firewalls, Maestro, SD-WAN, VPN, DDoS, SASE, IoT, Zero Trust, and Smart-1 management.- [Hybrid Mesh Network Security Overview](https://www.checkpoint.com/hybrid-mesh-network-security/): Zero Trust security across on-premises, cloud, and remote environments. Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader 2025.- [Check Point Firewalls](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/next-generation-firewall/): Enterprise firewalls with AI-powered threat prevention. Up to 75 Gbps Layer 1-7 throughput. 99.9% block rate. Secures GenAI tool usage and MCP traffic. Includes data center, perimeter, branch, and rugged form factors.- [Check Point Maestro Hyperscale Firewall](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/maestro-hyperscale-network-security/): Intelligent load-balancing firewall cluster scaling to 1 Tbps with 99.999% carrier-class resilience.- [Check Point Cloud Firewall](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/cloud-network-security/): Cloud-native security gateways providing industry-leading threat prevention across public, private, and hybrid clouds. Covers CNAPP, CSPM, cloud network security, and workload protection.- [Check Point WAF](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/waf/): AI-powered Web Application and API security. 99.5% detection rate, near-zero false positives, 100% zero-day blocking. Preemptively blocked Log4Shell and Spring4Shell. Leader in GigaOm Radar for Application and API Security.- [Check Point SD-WAN](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/sd-wan/): Optimized connectivity and security for branch and remote offices.- [Check Point Remote Access VPN](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/remote-access-vpn/): Secure corporate network access for remote and roaming users. Integrated into every Check Point firewall.- [Check Point DDoS Protection](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/ddos-protector/): 6 Gbps to 800 Gbps mitigation. Defends against burst attacks, DNS amplification, and IoT botnet floods.- [Zero Trust Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/solutions/zero-trust-security/): Zero Trust framework spanning networks, people, devices, data, and workloads. Forrester Wave Leader Q3 2025.- [Check Point Smart-1](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/unified-management/): Unified security management - centralized policy and firewall management across all environments via a single smart console.---## AI SecuritySecuring AI itself — workforce AI usage, AI agents, red teaming, and the annual AI security research.- [Check Point AI Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai-security/): Security for AI-first enterprises. One platform to discover, protect, and govern every AI interaction from employees to agents. Covers workforce, applications, and autonomous agents.- [Check Point Workforce AI Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai-security/ai-workforce-security/): a platform that discovers, governs, and protects how employees use AI across browsers, desktop apps, SaaS integrations, coding.- [Check Point AI Agent Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai-security/ai-agent-security/): Protects AI agents and agentic workflows from prompt injection, data leaks, and AI misuse. Intercepts tool calls before unsafe actions execute. Inspects MCP traffic and external content flows.- [Check Point AI Red Teaming](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai-security/ai-red-teaming/): Automated adversarial testing across 400+ foundation models, live applications, and agent endpoints.h].- [AI Security Report 2026](https://www.checkpoint.com/resources/all-assets-460c/report-ai-security-2026): Annual research on AI-driven attacks and enterprise defenses.---## Workspace SecurityProtection for users and their tools — endpoint, email, anti-phishing, mobile, browser, and SaaS.- [Workspace Security Platform](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/): Comprehensive workspace security. 100% detection in 2024 MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations. Single pane of glass across email, devices, browsers, and SaaS.- [Check Point Endpoint Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/endpoint/): EDR/EPP with automated vulnerability detection and patching. AV-TEST Top Product. Leading anti-ransomware platform per GigaOM.- [Check Point Email Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/email-security/): AI-powered protection against phishing, BEC, and malware across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.- [Check Point Mobile Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/mobile-security/): Mobile threat defense for iOS and Android against device vulnerabilities, OS exploits, and SMS phishing.- [Check Point Browser](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/advanced-endpoint-protection/browser-security/): Secure web access preventing phishing, malicious downloads, and brand spoofing.- [Check Point SaaS Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/saas/): SaaS Security Posture Management - uncovers shadow SaaS and remediates posture gaps.---## Exposure ManagementFinding and fixing risk before attackers use it — threat intel, prioritization, vulnerability management, safe remediation, and CTEM.- [Exposure Management](https://www.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/): Intelligence-led, remediation-driven CTEM platform. 93% true positive rate, 22-hour average takedown MTTR, 504 safe remediations per organization monthly.- [Check Point Threat Intelligence](https://www.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/threat-intelligence/): Dark web monitoring, brand protection, and attack surface management. Connects threat actor activity with vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.- [Check Point Exposure Prioritization](https://www.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/exposure-prioritization/):Ranks enterprise risks and vulnerabilities based on exploitability, threat actor activity, and asset criticality to focus remediation teams on the exposures that pose actual operational danger.- [Check Point Vulnerability Management](https://www.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/vulnerability-management/):Discovers, assesses, and tracks software flaws, system misconfigurations, and weak points across the IT estate to streamline patch cycles and close security gaps.- [Check Point Safe Remediation](https://www.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/safe-remediation/): Automatically validates and enforces fixes - virtual patching, takedowns, IPS activations, and configuration hardening - without disrupting operations.- [CTEM](https://www.checkpoint.com/solutions/continuous-threat-exposure-management/): Continuous Threat Exposure Management - scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization in an ongoing cycle.---## Threat Intelligence and ResearchPublic-facing intelligence and education — live threat map, blog, Cyber Hub, resource center, and annual reports.- [Resource Center](https://www.checkpoint.com/resources): Reports, ebooks, solution briefs, and research.- [Cyber Hub](https://www.checkpoint.com/cyber-hub/): Leading cyber security topics and educational content.- [Cyber Security Report 2026](https://www.checkpoint.com/security-report/): Annual global threat landscape report.- [GenAI-powered Assistants eBook](https://www.checkpoint.com/resources/items/ebook-transforming-security-management-with-genai-powered-assistants): Guide to transforming security management with GenAI.---## Customer Proof and Recognition- [Customer Stories](https://www.checkpoint.com/customer-stories/): Enterprise customer success stories across industries.- [Awards and Recognition](https://www.checkpoint.com/about-us/awards-and-recognition/): Gartner Magic Quadrant placements and industry awards.---## Getting Started- [Get a Demo](https://www.checkpoint.com/demos/): Request a product demonstration.- [Subscribe](https://pages.checkpoint.com/subscribe.html): Subscribe for threat intelligence updates.- [Incident Response](https://www.checkpoint.com/about-us/contact-incident-response/): Urgent help for active security incidents.- [Speak with a Global CISO](https://pages.checkpoint.com/global-ciso-engagement.html): Peer-level expert advice from experienced CISOs.---## Company Information- [About Us](https://www.checkpoint.com/about-us/): Company overview, mission, and leadership.- [Contact Check Point](https://www.checkpoint.com/about-us/contact-check-point/): Contact page and support access.---## External Resources- [Research](https://research.checkpoint.com/): CPR, Check Point's intelligence and research arm: malware, vulnerability, cybercrime and AI research, ransomware/intelligence reports, CPR Zero repository, Evasion Techniques Encyclopedia.- [Blog](https://blog.checkpoint.com): Security news, threat analysis, and product insights.- [SASE](https://sase.checkpoint.com/): Cloud-delivered SASE combining Check Point SASE Private Access, Check Point SASE Internet Access, and Check Point Enterprise Secure Browser.- [Engage](https://engage.checkpoint.com/): Check Point's customer and partner engagement hub for product updates, security resources, and events.---## Sitemap- [XML Sitemap](https://www.checkpoint.com/sitemap_index.xml): Main sitemap index for full site discoverability.
